title: Project Manager Assistant Director Global Learning Talent Services
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

 At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

 Seeking an experienced professional in learning design and development to join our team as a Global Learning Design and Development Project Manager, Assistant Director.
   

  

 EY’s Global Learning function designs, develops and deploys technical and non\-technical learning for EY professionals across the world. In the Design and development team, we are applying learning science and proven technology in the development and curation of the best learning content.
   

  

 We are looking for a colleague to join our virtual team working from over 20 geographical locations across the world. We offer flexible working, the chance to work in a multicultural and multinational environment, and best in class teaming and collaboration.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 This role in the global learning team that will give you the opportunity to make a difference by helping EY professionals globally grow their skills and accelerate their careers.
   

  

 This position is responsible for project management of design, development and curation of individual learning items and blended learning programs. The project manager will monitor the progress of instructional designers, developers, graphic artists, quality assurance specialists and all others associated with the design process. They will assist portfolio design leads and managers in overseeing and managing all design activities necessary to deliver learning products that meet EY’s design quality standards, on time and to budget. The project manager will also work to a set of agreed project management standards and processes and will share best practices to support the continuous improvement of design and development speed, efficiency, and quality. The project manager, Assistant Director, will be able to manage autonomously, with limited need for supervision.
   

  

 This role will provide the opportunity to work in a dynamic, fast paced environment supporting multiple projects at a time.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Deliver learning design and development projects (including large scale, highly complex projects) on time, to budget and quality standards
* Develop a detailed project plan for each project, based on a standard template, identifying deliverable due dates and review cycles
* Establish and maintain relationships with a variety of stakeholders including subject matter resources, other learning stakeholders, and third\-party learning vendors
* Ensure adherence to operations and compliance processes including procurement, finance, and Risk Management
* Coordinate and monitor the work of vendor project managers, designers, and developers where applicable
* Identify and assess risks and consult with leadership or stakeholders on options in a timely manner
* Facilitate and lead regular project and team meetings
* Create and maintain comprehensive project documentation
* Leverage and share best practices of project management with other team members
* Mentor and provide guidance to junior project managers on the team
* Make recommendations to leadership regarding competing priorities and resource management issues
* Initiate and ensure the effective and timely publication of learning content by content administration
* Measure project performance using appropriate systems, tools, and techniques


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**To qualify for the role you must have:**
* Minimum of 8\-10 years of experience in managing learning design and development projects, preferably at a global level and/or to a dispersed client base
* Demonstrable experience involving project management skills including management of vendors
* Demonstrable experience in concurrently managing multiple, large\-scale, and highly complex learning and development projects involving all delivery channels/types
* Demonstrable experience using project management software, including Microsoft Excel
* Demonstrable experience of having built and maintained strong relationships with business customers/clients, including at the senior or c\-suite level
* Demonstrable experience of thinking and acting strategically and commercially in pursuit of the wider EY business objectives
* Demonstratable experience of mentoring and providing guidance to junior team members


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Strong knowledge of \- and commitment to optimize \- learning end\-to\-end processes and standards
* Knowledge of learning science and evidence\-based design standards and practices to ensure that EY’s learning content is of the highest quality and has the desired business impact
* A bachelor’s degree and ideally higher professional or master’s qualification in a related discipline


**What We Look For**
* An experienced project manager who strives to improve process and exceed leadership’s needs
* A professional who can quickly problem solve and can offer perspective on solutions
* A professional who demonstrates resilience and is energized by working in a global environment, proactively seeking different opinions, valuing, and leveraging diverse perspectives


**What We Offer**
 As part of this role, you'll work in a highly integrated, global team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial, and social well\-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here’s a snapshot of what we offer:
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

* Assign and monitor work, ensuring quality and adherence to timelines

* Conduct design reviews, code reviews, and technical walkthroughs
* Build a strong quality driven and ownership focused delivery culture
* Participate in hiring, onboarding, and performance evaluations

**Technical Skills \& Experience**
* 7\+ years of experience in SAP data migration with strong BODS focus
* Proven track record of leading multiple end to end migration cycles

* SAP BODS architecture, design, and performance optimization

title: Incident & Change Management Coordinator
description:
Dodge Construction Network (Dodge) is looking for a detail\-oriented, process\-driven professional to build out and mature our Incident Management and Change Management functions. These functions currently exist but lack formal structure\-this role will own the transformation from ad hoc handling to a disciplined, auditable, well\-governed practice. You'll design and implement the processes, approval workflows, and reporting that give engineering, IT, and leadership confidence that incidents are resolved consistently and changes are reviewed, approved, and tracked before they hit production. ***Preferred Location***
 Qualified candidates should be based in or near Kochi and able to work from our Kochi office as part of a hybrid schedule.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
**Incident Management**
* Formalize incident management processes: severity classification, escalation paths, communication protocols, and resolution SLAs
* Own the incident lifecycle in Jira Service Management (or Jira), from detection/logging through resolution and closure
* Drive post\-incident reviews (blameless retrospectives / RCAs), ensure action items are tracked and closed, and report on recurring themes
* Build dashboards and recurring reports on incident volume, MTTR, severity trends, and SLA compliance for leadership visibility


**Change Management**
* Design and implement a formal Change Management process, including change categorization (standard/normal/emergency), risk assessment, and CAB (Change Advisory Board) review cadence
* Build structured Jira workflows and forms to capture change requests, required approvals, rollback plans, and post\-implementation review
* Partner with engineering, infrastructure, and application teams (AWS, M365, Atlassian, and internal platforms) to ensure changes are properly vetted before deployment
* Track change success/failure rates and use data to continuously refine the process


**Tooling, Automation \& Governance**
* Configure and maintain Jira workflows, schemes, automation rules, and Jira Service Management request forms to support both processes end\-to\-end
* Use Atlassian automation (Jira Automation, Confluence integrations, forms) to reduce manual steps\-auto\-routing, approval reminders, SLA breach alerts, ticket linking, etc.
* Maintain Confluence documentation: runbooks, process guides, RACI charts, and CAB meeting notes
* Establish approval workflows and audit trails that satisfy internal governance and any relevant compliance requirements
* Identify opportunities to integrate Incident/Change data with other systems (e.g., monitoring/alerting tools, CMDB\-type asset tracking) as the practice matures


**Cross\-Functional Coordination**
* Act as the process owner and point of contact across engineering, infrastructure, and vendor/contractor teams for all things incident and change related
* Facilitate CAB meetings and post\-incident reviews, keeping them efficient and action\-oriented
* Train and onboard teams on new processes, driving adoption without becoming a bottleneck


***Education Requirement***
 Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent education and work experience.
   

  

**Required Experience, Knowledge And Skills**
* 3\+ years of experience in Incident Management, Change Management, IT Service Management (ITSM), or a Project/Program Management role with process\-ownership responsibility
* Hands\-on experience administering Atlassian products\-Jira and/or Jira Service Management required; Confluence experience strongly preferred
* Demonstrated experience building Jira workflows, automation rules, and forms (Jira Service Management request forms or similar) \- this is not just "used Jira," but "configured Jira."
* Strong understanding of ITIL\-aligned incident and change management concepts (formal ITIL certification is a plus, not required)
* Excellent organizational skills with the ability to build structure from ambiguity\-you'll be creating a lot of this from scratch
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable facilitating meetings with technical and non\-technical stakeholders, including leadership
* Data\-oriented mindset\-comfortable building reports/dashboards to show process health and drive continuous improvement
* Experience working in a technical environment (cloud infrastructure, SaaS, or software engineering organization) is a strong plus, even if you're not an engineer yourself


**Preferred Experience, Knowledge And Skills**
* ITIL v3/v4 Foundation certification
* Experience with Jira Service Management's Change and Incident\-specific templates/features
* Familiarity with AWS or Microsoft 365 environments (you won't need to administer them but understanding what a "change" looks like in these environments helps)
